title: Candlelight Dinner Packages | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: Candlelight Processional Dining PackagesSavor a delicious meal and enjoy guaranteed seats to Candlelight Processional during EPCOT International Festival of the Holidays—November 27 to December 30, 2026. Check back soon for more details!A Festive FeastEnjoy a holiday meal for the senses when you book a Candlelight Processional Dining Package, which includes:A mouthwatering meal at an EPCOT eateryA guaranteed seat at one of the Candlelight Processional performances that same dayMore Seasonal Experiences at EPCOTDISNEY ON BROADWAY Concert Series Dining PackagesDine and be delighted by DISNEY ON BROADWAY tunes at EPCOT International Festival of the Arts.Garden Rocks Dining PackagesEnjoy a perfect pairing of flavor and fun during EPCOT International Flower & Garden Festival.Concert Series Dining PackagesRock out to renowned bands and delight in tasty eats at EPCOT International Food & Wine Festival.
